quotes.text: After seeing all the balloons over our hotel we decided to try and book a flight. Compass had great pricing, online registration and availability for the next morning. Registration process was quick and easy and we met crew at nearby vineyard the next morning for our sunrise flight. Pilot Tim and ground crew Ash and Trevor were friendly, customer focused and professional. Had a great experience from start to finish. Landing was smooth and easy. If you are in the area, add a balloon flight to your plans and fly with Compass. They don’t have tons of reviews but won’t disappoint!
